children: The appointment adds Gujarat to his existing regional responsibilities across Pune and up-country Maharashtra

Hitachi Systems India has elevated Vimal Bhat, currently Vice President, to Business Head – Gujarat, expanding his regional responsibilities to cover Gujarat alongside Pune and up-country Maharashtra. The appointment marks a further step in Bhat’s career at the company, where he has held sales and leadership positions for over 13 years. His experience spans enterprise sales, cybersecurity, cloud solutions, business development and customer account management.

Bhat joined Hitachi Systems India in May 2013 as Enterprise Account Manager. He subsequently moved through several roles, including AGM Sales from January 2017, AVP Sales from April 2018 and Senior AVP from April 2021. He became Vice President in April 2022 and is based in Pune, Maharashtra.

His expanded remit brings Gujarat into his existing regional responsibilities. His professional experience includes managing enterprise accounts, developing business relationships and overseeing sales operations. The company has not disclosed further details about the appointment or any changes to his reporting structure.

Bhat’s professional background covers nearly two decades across sales, financial advisory, enterprise account management and technology solutions. His areas of expertise include cloud services and cybersecurity, with a focus on helping businesses strengthen data infrastructure and manage technology-related risks.

His career at Hitachi Systems India has included responsibilities across customer engagement, business development and regional operations. He has also emphasised team management and sales performance as key elements of his leadership approach.

Before joining Hitachi Systems India, Bhat worked as an Account Manager at MIEL e-Security from December 2008 to April 2013. He began his career at Green Biotics as a Sales Executive in October 2004, remaining there until July 2006.

He subsequently worked as a Financial Advisor at Kotak Mahindra Bank from August 2006 to December 2007 and as Senior Executive – Sales at Netcore Solutions from December 2007 to December 2008. These roles provided experience across financial services, sales and customer relationship management.

Bhat holds a Bachelor of Computer Science degree from Savitribai Phule Pune University. His career progression at Hitachi Systems India has taken him from enterprise account management to senior sales leadership, with his latest appointment extending his regional responsibilities to Gujarat.
